Component descriptions: The following components have usage descriptions or documentation links defined in Figma. These descriptions provide important context about the intended usage, best practices, and any constraints for each component. Follow these guidelines when implementing or using these components.

## Device=Desktop, Mode=Modules
**Node ID:** 469:41552

Shared Capiro 3.1 Desktop header with Modules selected. Logo returns to Dashboard; three modes are Meri, Portfolio and Modules. Native portrait is a neutral illustration. Wire navigation on page-local instances.

## Capiro 3.1/Shared header
**Node ID:** 469:92041

Shared Capiro navigation with Meri, Portfolio and Modules modes; Master calendar, Search, Updates and Profile actions. Desktop uses action labels; tablet and phone use icons. Prototype actions are mapped on screen instances to same-device destinations. Compact icon-only mode switcher: sparkle = Meri; briefcase = Portfolio; grid = Modules. Selected tile retains a visible surface and outline. Preserve semantic labels, accessible mode names and current-section navigation when implemented.

## v2/Button
**Node ID:** 12:388

shadcn/ui <Button> (new-york v4). h-9 px-3.5 rounded-\[10px\] text-sm font-medium. Primary | Outline (shadow-xs) | Ghost. Chevron = <Select> trigger look.

## icon/sparkle
**Node ID:** 4:9

Lucide-style sparkle icon. Recolor via the vector stroke.

## icon/layout-grid
**Node ID:** 4:26

Lucide-style layout-grid icon. Recolor via the vector stroke.

## icon/search
**Node ID:** 4:13

Lucide-style search icon. Recolor via the vector stroke.

## icon/bell
**Node ID:** 4:17

Lucide-style bell icon. Recolor via the vector stroke.

## Capiro 3.1/Profile picture
**Node ID:** 469:41439

Neutral editable portrait illustration used for the current-user profile control in the prototype. Replace with the signed-in user image in implementation.

## Device=Desktop, Context=Modules
**Node ID:** 471:92526

Capiro3.1 Modules Desktop navigation. Labels and native icons. Current item is a default highlight; override selected fills in screen instances. Reactions are wired on the prototype-page instances.

## Capiro 3.1/Shared sidebar
**Node ID:** 471:92866

Shared Capiro3.1 application navigation. Contexts are Portfolio, Client and Modules; Desktop232px and Tablet72px widths. Client default scope is Anduril. Settings remains a bottom action. Settings pages retain their existing settings rail. Wire native navigation reactions on page-local instances.

## icon/settings · Capiro 3.1
**Node ID:** 471:92354

Native editable settings cog, matching the local 16px line icon system.

## Tab=Prep, State=Upcoming
**Node ID:** 373:38023

Meeting detail panel from current Engagement Manager code: Prep, Meeting Notes and Debrief. Saving, approval and per-artifact sharing are separate. Debrief is locked before the meeting ends. No standalone outreach or linked Work workflow.

## v2/Engagement · Meeting workspace
**Node ID:** 373:38027

Shared meeting MTG-1042 workspace. Tab changes preserve record identity and status overrides. Initial entry: upcoming→Prep, live→Notes, completed→Debrief. Expand and Close are wired per screen to retain source context. All four tabs remain available. Content snapshots illustrate the meeting lifecycle.
